name: House Redoran
description: The Great House of the warrior tradition, guardians of Morrowind's honor and of the Ghostfence.

name: House Telvanni
motto: Power and Mora, Wisdom and Profit
description: The Great House of mage-lords, growing towers of fungus and brooking no authority but their own.

name: House Hlaalu
motto: Prosperity, Profit, and the Favor of the Empire
description: The Great House of merchants and politicians, most open to Imperial influence and trade.

name: Tribunal Temple
description: The state religion of Morrowind, devoted to the living gods Almalexia, Sotha Sil and Vivec.

name: Imperial Cult
description: Missionaries of the Nine Divines spreading the Imperial faith through every province.

name: Mages Guild
description: The guild of magicka, monopolizing magical services and research across the Empire.

name: Fighters Guild
description: Hired muscle for the Empire — mercenaries, guards and sellswords under Imperial charter.

name: Thieves Guild
description: The shadow network of fences, lockpicks and informants that runs Balmora's corners.

name: Morag Tong
description: The ancient, lawful assassins' guild of Morrowind, servants of Mephala, whose contracts are bound by writ.

name: The Blades
description: The Emperor's secret service — spies, bodyguards and troubleshooters loyal to the Dragon Throne.
